## Heat-resistant borosilicate glass

High-borosilicate glass (often called 3.3 borosilicate) has low thermal expansion, so it tolerates hot water and temperature changes much better than soda-lime glass. Shanxi now has automated production lines for borosilicate tableware alongside traditional lamp-worked items.

- Teapots with stainless or glass infusers
- Double-wall coffee and tea cups
- Carafes and pitchers
- Food storage containers with bamboo or PP lids
- Food-contact testing (LFGB/FDA) available on request

name: Glass Perfume Bottles
summary: Heavy-base glass perfume bottles in 30–160 ml: clear, air-bubble, polished, hot-fused, spray-coated and hand-made finishes, with matching caps and pumps.
description:
## Perfume and fragrance glass bottles from China

We supply glass perfume bottles and fragrance bottles to perfume brands, private-label perfumers, gift companies and packaging distributors. Most of our designs are heavy-base bottles in high-clarity flint glass. The thick, polished base gives the bottle weight in the hand and sparkle on the shelf.

**Finishes and decoration**
- **Clear bottles**: crystal-clear flint glass, the base for most custom decoration
- **Air-bubble (bubble) perfume bottles**: bubbles formed inside the thick glass, so every piece is slightly different
- **Polished and faceted**: polished facets that catch the light like a cut gem
- **Hot-fused decoration**: glass elements fused onto the bottle while hot, so the design is part of the glass
- **Spray-coated**: solid, gradient, matte, metallic or pearlescent colors matched to your Pantone reference
- **Gold and silver leaf inclusions**: a sealed bubble of real leaf inside the base
- **Hand-made**: free-formed artisan bottles in small batches

**Typical specifications**
- Capacity 30–160 ml; glass weight about 150–350 g
- 15 mm crimp neck (FEA 15) or screw neck, matched to your pump and collar
- Caps in zinc alloy, Surlyn, wood or acrylic
- Logo by screen printing, hot stamping, decal or engraving

## Perfume bottle FAQ

**What is the MOQ for glass perfume bottles?**
It depends on the mold and decoration. Stock-mold bottles start from about 5,000 pieces, decorated and specialty bottles from about 2,000–3,000 pieces, and hand-made or gold-leaf designs from 500 pieces per design. Each product page lists the current MOQ. Read [what drives custom perfume bottle cost and MOQ](/blog/custom-perfume-bottle-cost-moq-what-drives-price).

**Do you supply pumps, collars and caps?**
Yes. We can supply the bottle, pump, collar and cap as a matched set, and send samples before mass production so you can test the fit. Our guide to [FEA 15 crimp vs screw necks](/blog/perfume-bottle-neck-finish-fea-15-crimp-vs-screw-neck) explains how to match a pump.

**Do you work with buyers in Hong Kong?**
Yes. Many fragrance brands and packaging traders in Hong Kong source bottles made in mainland China. Read [Hong Kong supplier vs mainland factory](/blog/perfume-glass-bottle-supplier-hong-kong-vs-china) to compare the two routes.

**How do I choose a perfume bottle supplier?**
Check the neck finish, glass weight, decoration method, samples and packaging. Our [10-point checklist for choosing a perfume bottle supplier in China](/blog/how-to-choose-glass-perfume-bottle-supplier-china) covers each step.

Send your target capacity, neck finish and reference photos, and we will shortlist matching stock molds or quote a new mold.

seo_description: Wholesale perfume and fragrance glass bottles from China: 30–160 ml heavy-base, bubble, faceted and spray-coated bottles with FEA 15 crimp neck. OEM.

name: Reed Diffuser & Aroma Bottles
summary: Thick-wall glass reed diffuser bottles in 100–200 ml for home-fragrance brands, with stoppers, collars and reeds available.
description:
## Reed diffuser and home-fragrance glass bottles from China

We supply glass reed diffuser bottles and aroma bottles to home-fragrance brands, candle and diffuser makers, hotels and gift companies. The bottles are made of thick flint glass, in round, square and dome shapes. A heavy base keeps the bottle stable, and a narrow neck slows evaporation and holds the reeds upright.

**Options**
- Capacities about 100–200 ml
- Clear, frosted, amber or spray-colored glass, with colors from one stock mold
- Screw caps, cork or wooden stoppers, and metal collars
- Rattan or fiber reeds, supplied with the bottle
- Logo by screen printing, hot stamping or decal
- Gift boxes for retail and hotel amenity programs

## Reed diffuser bottle FAQ

**What is the MOQ for reed diffuser bottles?**
Our current diffuser bottles start from about 3,000 pieces. Spray colors and custom decoration are quoted per color.

**Can you supply the bottle, stopper and reeds as a set?**
Yes. We can quote the bottle with a stopper or cap, a collar and reeds, and pack them together for retail.

**Which neck size do I need?**
A narrow neck reduces evaporation, but it must fit the number and thickness of reeds you plan to use. Send your reed specification and we will confirm the neck size before sampling.

**Do you work with buyers in Hong Kong?**
Yes. Many home-fragrance brands and traders in Hong Kong buy diffuser bottles made in mainland China. Read [Hong Kong supplier vs mainland factory](/blog/perfume-glass-bottle-supplier-hong-kong-vs-china) to compare the two routes.

Send your target capacity, shape, finish and reeds, and we will shortlist stock molds or quote a custom design.
seo_title: Reed Diffuser Glass Bottles from China Factories | Wholesale
seo_description: Wholesale reed diffuser glass bottles from China: 100–200 ml thick-wall bottles in clear, frosted, amber or spray colors, with stoppers and reeds.
